name: Zone Buster
idea: Against a zone, stand in the gaps and pass fast until a shooter is wide open.
why: In a zone, each defender guards an area, not a player. Quick passes make the zone slide back and forth, and a pass into the middle pulls everyone in. Then a shooter on the outside is left all alone.
tryit: Put out five cones as the zone. Stand in a gap between two cones, never right next to one. Pass into the middle, then kick it out to the shooter.

frames.say: Red is playing a *zone*: each defender guards an area, not a player. Blue stands in the *gaps* between them.
{1} passes to {2}. The whole zone slides over toward the ball.
{2} passes into the middle to {5}. The defenders crowd {5}, and nobody is near {3}!
*Kick it out:* {5} passes to {3}. {X3} has a long way to run!
{3} shoots a three! Quick passes and finding the gaps beat a zone.
